messages.author: HOCHEOL LIM
messages.body:
Dear All,
There are errors in tiMerge with ff19SB.
When I changed ff19SB to ff14SB, it worked.
I copied the error message.
In pdb file, there is no ASP137 and LEU30, but GLN137 and ALA30 (LEU31).
I tried to make a mask between ALA30 and ASP138.
Thank you.
